question: The Buddhist festival 'Sogkran' is celebrated mainly in which of the following Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Buddhist festival '**Songkran**' is celebrated mainly in **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• This Buddhist festival is observed as a spring cleaning.
 
• It is celebrated for several days during the middle of April, people clean their houses wash clothes and enjoy sprinkling perfumed water on the monks. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 **Most popular festivals celebrated in Arunachal Pradesh:**

 
 
• Siang River Festival
 
• Pangsau Pass Winter Festival
